name: Ooredoo Q.P.S.C.
summary: Ooredoo Q.P.S.C., together with its subsidiaries, provides telecommunications services in Qatar, rest of the Middle East, Asia, and North Africa region. It operates through Ooredoo Qatar, Asiacell, Ooredoo Hutchison Asia, Ooredoo Oman, Ooredoo Algeria, and Ooredoo Kuwait segments. The company offers cellular, mobile and fixed telecommunications, internet service provider, multimedia, data communication, and internet services; fixed voice, connectivity, and broadband products; home and internet TV; smart phones, tablets, internet devices, and accessories; mobile wallet; and entertainment services. It also provides push to talk services; mobile satellite; Aamali bulk SMS, mobile money payroll,…
